lessons.text: To find an existing ERP vendor and bills, use the read-only ERP API: GET /vendors?q=<name> to get vendor id and email_domain, then GET /bills?vendor_id=<id>. If a bill with the invoice number already exists, use that bill record instead of creating a new one.

To schedule payment for an existing bill, open /erp/bills/<bill_id> in the ERP, fill the "Payment date" field (YYYY-MM-DD), and click the schedule button. For amounts >= INR 50,000, Finance Manager approval is required; if the action returns "approval declined (large-payment)", do not retry and report the block to the AP lead.

If no invoice email is found in the AP mailbox for a vendor, don't stop; check ERP for an existing recorded bill (e.g., created_by seed). Use the ERP bill's due date and amount, and note that no sender domain validation is possible without an email, but vendor email_domain can still be checked in the vendor master.
The ERP vendor master contains an "email_domain" field used to validate sender domains against invoices as part of fraud checks.
The AP lead's internal email address is priya.nair@kestrel.in; all AP confirmation or status emails should be sent to this address via /mail/compose.
